# `codec2_3200` test fixtures

Reference data for cross-validating `src/codec2_3200/`'s independent Rust
implementation against the real Codec2-mod C reference (see
`src/codec2_3200/mod.rs`'s own module doc comment for why this is an
independent implementation rather than a port). Captured with a small
instrumentation patch (`-DCODEC2_INSTRUMENT`, not part of Codec2-mod's own
real source) added to a local build of `vendor/codec2-mod/`, which logs
real intermediate values -- `R[]`, `ak[]`, `P[]`/`Q[]`, `lsp[]`, encoder-side
energy -- at specific call sites, one line per real analysis frame.

## What's committed, and why

- `codec2_r_dump.txt`, `codec2_ak_dump.txt`, `codec2_pq_dump.txt`,
  `codec2_lsp_dump.txt`, `codec2_enc_e_dump.txt`: derived from running the
  real reference against the standard Codec2/FreeDV project's own publicly
  committed test speech (the project leadership team's own donated voice
  samples, from `drowe67/codec2`'s `raw/` directory -- callsigns
  `g8sez`/`vk5dgr`/`k0pfx`/`mooneer`/a fifth clip appear in the source
  filenames). These files hold only *abstracted numeric analysis features*
  (LPC coefficients, Chebyshev polynomial coefficients, LSP frequencies in
  radians, a single energy scalar per frame) -- not audio waveform data,
  and not byte-recoverable back into speech. Subsampled (every 7th frame)
  from a larger local capture to keep the fixture small; frame indices are
  not meaningful outside this file.
- `synthetic_codec2_wn_dump.txt`, `synthetic_codec2_r_dump.txt`: the
  reference's real windowed analysis buffer (`Wn[]`, which *is*
  essentially audio-domain data -- real samples, just multiplied by a Hann
  window) and its corresponding `R[]`, but captured from a locally
  synthesized, non-speech test signal (swept sinusoids plus a little
  deterministic pseudo-noise, generated by a short Python script, not
  checked in) instead of anyone's real recorded voice. Used only by
  `lpc::tests::autocorrelate_matches_the_real_reference_r_on_real_captured_wn_data`
  to cross-check `window.rs`'s normalization scale against the reference.

Deliberately **not** committed: any dump of real `Wn[]`/`Sn[]` (actual
speech waveform samples) from the real donated voice recordings above --
unlike the scalar features, that's audio-domain data close enough to the
original recordings to warrant the same caution `tests/fixtures/`'s own
`.gitignore` entry already applies to the real off-air WSPR recording used
elsewhere in this crate.

## Regenerating

The instrumentation patch and capture script aren't checked in (they lived
in a session scratchpad). To recapture: add `INSTR_DUMP_*` calls (see
`inc/instrument.h`'s existing macros for the pattern) at the relevant call
sites in a local `vendor/codec2-mod/` checkout, build with
`-DCODEC2_INSTRUMENT`, and run against real speech (any 8kHz mono WAV) for
the five real-speech-derived files, or a synthesized non-speech signal for
the two `synthetic_*` files.
